opus.problem: Gives the word away on its own: a woman made from the man's rib in Eden is unmistakably Eve to almost any baker, so it is not medium hard.
Gives the word away on its own: the woman in the garden who ate the fruit and gave some to her husband is the single best-known Eve fact.
Gives the word away on its own: naming Adam and saying he listened to 'her' voice makes her Adam's wife, which is just Eve.
Nearly gives the word away on its own: the woman who bore Cain is widely known to be Eve, the only mother of Cain in the Bible.
